reader.decision: Approve the allowlist in runner/spawn.py (delete DENYLIST, add ALLOWLIST of PATH, HOME, LANG, HTTPS_PROXY plus TINKERBOX_* prefix) and add the one sentence to docs/plugin-contract.md. Do not do the two-name denylist edit.
reader.decision_reason: The message shows the denylist leaves BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET exposed and every future secret leaks by default, while the allowlist fixes the root cause. The message also says it matches what the plugins in the repo use today and that it found no plugin needing other variables.

reconstruction.problem: plugin_env copies all of os.environ and removes only three named keys (AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, DATABASE_URL, GITHUB_TOKEN), so any new secret reaches every plugin. STRIPE_API_KEY was added to deploy/runner.env on 2 October and nobody updated DENYLIST. With debug set, feed-fetch dumps its whole environment to stderr (plugins/feed-fetch/main.py:14), and a customer pasted that into a public ticket on 24 October.
reconstruction.what_breaks: STRIPE_API_KEY and SENTRY_DSN leaked and the key had to be rotated. BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET is still in the environment and would leak the same way. Adding only the two names to the denylist would leave it exposed.
reconstruction.fix: Replace the denylist with an allowlist in runner/spawn.py. Keep only PATH, HOME, LANG, HTTPS_PROXY and variables starting with TINKERBOX_. Add one sentence to docs/plugin-contract.md describing this. The debug dump in feed-fetch stays and can be removed separately.
reconstruction.cost: A plugin that needs any other variable will fail until that name is added to ALLOWLIST. The message says this is deliberate and that it found no such plugin in the repo. The change touches two files, so it is larger than a three-name denylist edit.

follow_up_questions: Are there third-party or out-of-repo plugins that rely on inherited environment variables beyond the allowlist? The message says to use the denylist only if there are, and it only says it found none in the repo.
reader.closing_answer: I approve the allowlist in runner/spawn.py, not the three-name denylist extension.
